Game Overview

In Co-omets, the core idea is straightforward: navigate cosmic chaos in Co-omets, a retro-style arcade game designed for four-player co-op action. Strategize with your friends to dodge meteors and collect power-ups. Rely on teamwork, quick reflexes, and clever tactics to survive this thrilling interstellar adventure. Dare to conquer the galaxy together!
